answer: Divergent-Commitment Lottery. Each identity must publish a unique, signed nonce sequence before a fixed horizon; clones sharing state cannot produce divergent sequences without forking. Enforcement: duplicate commitment paths collapse into one lottery ticket, so N clones earn one identity's expected reward. An attacker pays full compute and registration cost per clone while receiving 1/N yield, and must also fund sustained divergence storage across a tundra-like cold archive and marble-hard audit logs to evade collapse.
